sources.citation: Ospina-Bozzi, Ana Maria & Joan Sebastian Gutierrez Rodriguez. 2025. Gentes y maneras de hablar en el rio Apaporis (Colombia): el caso de YAUNA, TANIMUCA y LETUAMA. Tipiti: Journal of the Society for the Anthropology of Lowland South America 21(1): 70-92. DOI 10.70845/2572-3626.1417.
sources.note: Nothing about Envuelto (the language is not mentioned). The article is ethnohistorical/sociolinguistic (origin and meaning of the names Yauna, Tanimuca, Letuama; oral history; exogamy; 20th-c. documentation by Koch-Grunberg, Schmidt, Tastevin, Loukotka). Its only prosodic content concerns the Tucanoan languages: footnote 15 (p. 79) states the transcription convention 'Nuestra transcripcion usa el alfabeto tanimuca-letuama vigente, pero incluimos tonos.' [Our transcription uses the current Tanimuca-Letuama alphabet, but we include tones], and the cited Yauna/Letuama forms carry tone diacritics…
